law.catch_line: No implied warranties for free software

text.section: In this section, "free software" means a computer program with respect to which the licensor does not intend to make a profit from the distribution of the copy of the program and does not act generally for commercial gain derived from controlling use of the program or making, modifying, or redistributing copies of the program.
The warranties under §§ 59.1-504.1 and 59.1-504.3 do not apply to free software.
